subject: OneTrust delegated evidence & incremental proofing plan
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delegated access & incremental evidence plan for OneTrust

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We need to get Redwood's OneTrust profile into a state where our procurement/audit team can complete the initial assessment by end of month. A couple of constraints on our side:

- We prefer delegated evidence uploads (uploader role) instead of you uploading everything manually.
- We want to take an incremental approach—first pass is CAIQ sections A/B/C + SOC2 artifacts; follow-ups for runtime logs.
- Rotation/credential update windows need to be coordinated with our infra team (Rahul Singh is CC'd).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Create a role for a short-lived upload connector (can be S3-pre-signed or portal Uploader role)
2) Accept an initial batch (10-15 artifacts) this week and then a second pass next week
3) Provide a brief runbook we can attach to our vendor intake ticket?

I'm attaching our internal intake (Acme-Onboarding-SLA.pdf) and will map expectations on our side. If you need a DocuSign for the data handling section, we can get that out today.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: Acme-Onboarding-SLA.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-health.com>
Cc: Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@procuret.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated access & incremental evidence plan for OneTrust

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask. We can support your incremental approach; proposed playbook below.

Plan (short):
- Day 0: We provision a scoped OneTrust "Uploader" role for a Redwood service account (or provide S3 pre-signed upload instructions). This account will be locked to only the profile and evidence upload actions.
- Canary batch (you): 10 artifacts — CAIQ sections A/B/C + SOC2 certs. We upload and flag artifacts with your ticket ID for traceability.
- Day 3: Review with your security contact (Rahul) to validate metadata/TTL.
- Follow-ups: Additional CAIQ sections and runtime logs in the next sprint (we recommend 2-week cadence).

Deliverables we'll send:
- onboarding-checklist.xlsx (attached) — step-by-step tasks for both teams
- ephemeral upload instructions for S3 (if you prefer)
- CAIQ mapping template (PDF) after first batch

I'll loop in Marissa from our portal ops to confirm the TTL and uploader policy. Do you have a preferred upload window (M-F, PST) and an internal ticket number we should reference?

—Karthik
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated access & incremental evidence plan for OneTrust

Hi all — quick ops notes from portal side:

- Prefer S3 pre-signed object uploads for large artifacts (>10MB). For smaller artifacts we'll provision a portal uploader role with the following constraints: profile-scoped, upload-only, no delete, TTL 30 days for ephemeral logs.
- For SOC2 report artifacts we set TTL to 365 days (searchable) to satisfy audit needs.
- I'll attach a rotation schedule template (rotation-schedule.csv) — please fill in who owns credential rotation (Redwood vs Acme) and the rotation cadence (recommended 90 days).

Operational ask: Sophie — can Rahul and your security ops accept SSH-key or API-key rotation windows? We try to schedule the actual rolling in a 1-hour maintenance window to avoid mid-sprint failures.

I'll also prepare a short runbook with screenshots for the uploader flow and share a Drive link once that's ready.

Thanks,
Marissa
Portal Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rotation-schedule.csv

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — that approach works for us. A few clarifications:

- Preferred upload window: Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 PST.
- Ticket reference: ACME-TICKET-5421. Please add that to the artifact metadata.
- DocuSign: we'll go ahead and sign the limited-data NDA; envelope link below.

We will start with 12 artifacts for the canary batch (CAIQ A/B + SOC2 cert + encryption KMS proof). Rahul, can you confirm the rotation windows?

Link: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

I'll upload once Karthik confirms role/URL.

Best,
Sophie
